name: Cloudflare
description: Monitor Cloudflare security settings including TLS/SSL configuration and WAF firewall rules for compliance evidence

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to the Cloudflare Dashboard at https://dash.cloudflare.com.
2. Go to My Profile > API Tokens > Create Token > Create Custom Token.
3. Grant these permissions:
   - Zone > Zone > Read
   - Zone > Zone Settings > Read
   - Zone > WAF > Read
   - (optional) Zone > SSL and Certificates > Read — enables TLS certificate detail in the TLS/HTTPS check
4. Set Zone Resources to 'All zones' (recommended — lets Comp AI auto-detect every domain).
5. Click Continue to summary > Create Token, copy the generated token, and paste it below. That's it — Comp AI automatically discovers the zones (domains) your token can access; you do NOT need to enter Zone IDs.

IMPORTANT — use an API Token, NOT the Global API Key:
 - This integration only works with a Cloudflare API Token (created via the Create Token button above).
 - Do NOT paste the Global API Key — it appears lower on the same 'API Tokens' page under the 'API Keys' section (a 37-character key with a View button). It is a different, legacy credential type and Cloudflare will reject it here, causing every check to fail with an authorization error.

Notes:
 - A Cloudflare 'zone' is a DNS domain (e.g. example.com). These checks monitor domain security: TLS/SSL mode, WAF, and zone status.
 - Cloudflare Workers and Pages are account-scoped and have no zones, so they are not covered by these checks.
 - To limit monitoring to specific domains, you can optionally enter their Zone IDs (comma-separated) in the Zone IDs field; otherwise all accessible zones are monitored.

credentialFields.label: API Token
credentialFields.helpText: Create a custom API Token in Cloudflare Dashboard > My Profile > API Tokens > Create Token, with Zone:Read, Zone Settings:Read, and Zone WAF:Read for all zones you want to monitor. Must be an API Token — NOT the Global API Key shown in the 'API Keys' section of the same page (the Global API Key will be rejected).

checks.name: TLS / HTTPS
checks.description: Verifies that Cloudflare SSL/TLS encryption mode is set to Full or Strict for end-to-end encryption across all monitored zones

checks.name: Production Firewall
checks.description: Verifies that Cloudflare WAF firewall rules are configured and active across all monitored zones

checks.name: Encryption at Rest
checks.description: Verifies Cloudflare data stores encryption at rest across all monitored zones - all Cloudflare storage is encrypted at rest by default using AES-256

checks.name: App Availability
checks.description: Verifies Cloudflare zones are active with DDoS protection and performance features enabled
